$comment: Testing accounts, seeded at startup when KIRIKO_SEED_DEV_USERS=1.
Copy this file to $KIRIKO_DATA_DIR/seed-users.json and edit it; that copy is
gitignored, so the addresses your team tests with stay out of the repository.
Every listed account gets the shared KIRIKO_SEED_PASSWORD, reset on every
start. Accounts not listed here are left alone. Roles: admin, member, viewer.
Omit the file entirely to fall back to the built-in admin/member/viewer set.
